record.question: Which social value requires Mizo youth to help in community work without expecting payment?
record.explanation: Hnatlang is collective labour for community welfare, traditionally contributed without wages. The Mizoram Samagra Shiksha account explicitly describes it as unpaid social/group work. Reference: https://samagra.mizoram.gov.in/page/civil-works; https://mamit.nic.in/culture-heritage/. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
